card.name: Medication-assisted treatment phrase
card.fires_on: The word "assisted" (or its piece "isted") in "medication-assisted treatment" of opioid use disorder. It also fires once on "Male" at the start of a plant flower description.

modes.label: Medication-assisted treatment
modes.description: Responds to "assisted" or "isted" right after "medication" in the phrase before "treatment of opioid use disorder".
modes.example: Treatment should include evidence-based approaches, such as medication-ass<<isted>> treatment of opioid use disorder.

modes.label: Plant flower description
modes.description: Responds to "Male" opening a description of flowers in a plant key.
modes.example: margins and midrib of lower surface prickly (serrate). Flowers:<< Male>> flowers tiny, in dense, white inf
